title: Automate KMS/HSM + TLS certificate rotation for Private Installer (Helm + Terraform)
author: Priya Nair
description: Summary: Add automated rotation for TLS certificates and KMS/HSM integration in the Private Installer. This PR introduces a cert-rotator controller, Helm chart hooks, Terraform module updates to manage KMS keys and HSM bindings, and operational docs + upgrade/rollback safety checks. Motivation: customers deploying Private require automated cert and key rotation for compliance (SOC2/ISO) and to reduce operational toil. Manual rotation steps previously caused outages during upgrades; this aims to make rotation idempotent, observable, and reversible. What changed (high level): - New controller: controllers/cert-rotator: watches Certificate CRs (and sealed secrets) and coordinates issuance via Vault or configured KMS/HSM providers, writes rotated certs to sealed secrets so they remain encrypted in gitops flows. - Helm chart changes: charts/private-installer: adds post-install/post-upgrade hooks to run preflight backups of sealed secrets, new templates for cert-rotation CronJob (optional), RBAC rules for cert-rotator. - Terraform: terraform/modules/kms: new resources and variables to create KMS keys, rotation schedule, and optional HSM binding (pkcs11 / cloud-hsm role attachment). - Migration/upgrade: docs/upgrade-guide.md and charts hooks implement a safe pre-upgrade snapshot of sealed secrets and a canary rollout flag to apply rotated certs to one node pool at a time. - Scripts and tooling: scripts/rotate-certs.sh for ad-hoc rotation runbooks; make target (make rotate-certs) to simulate rotation in CI. Checklist: [x] Controller to request certs from Vault/KMS/HSM providers [x] Helm templates + hooks [x] Terraform module and examples [x] RBAC least-privilege for controller [x] Pre-upgrade backup + rollback plan [x] E2E test harness for rotation flow (CI) Commits (summary): - feat(cert-rotator): implement main controller loop + reconciliation logic - feat(helm): add cert-rotation templates and hooks - feat(terraform): add kms module, variables, and examples - docs: add upgrade guide, migration notes, and operator runbook - ci: add e2e test for rotation flow and make targets Files/areas touched (high-level): - controllers/cert-rotator/main.go - charts/private-installer/templates/cert-rotation-cronjob.yaml - charts/private-installer/templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-backup.yaml - terraform/modules/kms/main.tf - terraform/examples/private-installer-kms/ - scripts/rotate-certs.sh - docs/upgrade-guide.md - tests/e2e/cert_rotation_test.go - Makefile - charts/private-installer/values.schema.json Key behaviors and design notes: - Primary issuer is Vault (defaults to nil). If vault not configured but a cloud KMS is configured, the controller will rely on an internal CSR flow with keys protected via the configured KMS or HSM provider. - SealedSecrets (sops/bitnami sealed-secrets compatibility) are used so rotated secrets remain encrypted for gitops repositories. The controller writes to SealedSecret resources; Helm hooks support snapshot/restore. - Rotation schedule: default 90 days; configurable via Helm values and TF module var. A forced rotation API (kubectl annotate sealedsecret rotate=true) is supported for emergency key swaps. - HSM support: Terraform module exposes a binding option that attaches PKCS#11 credentials or cloud HSM roles; controller supports PKCS#11 provider plugin (enabled via values). - Safety: We added a preflight backup that exports current sealed secrets to a kube secret in a backup namespace encrypted with customer KMS key; Helm pre-upgrade hook will fail the upgrade if backup fails. - Rollback: Helm pre-rollback hook and a restore script to revert sealed secrets from backups created by the hook. CI summary: - Initial run: lint/helm failed due to missing chart schema error -> fixed values.schema.json - E2E integration initially failed on RBAC (controller couldn't patch sealedsecret) -> tightened RBAC and re-ran - Final CI: all checks passed (helm lint, terraform fmt + validate, unit tests, e2e cert rotation test) Migration notes (single-line): Run `make snapshot-sealed-secrets` before upgrading; follow docs/upgrade-guide.md for step-by-step rollback. Related tickets/notes: Linear ENG-1942 (private installer cert rotation), SEC-312 (audit: cert rotation compliance). Merge: squashed and merged to main (merge method: squash).
